scope: Real synthetic directory reads in isolated Node subprocesses; no Electron UI or provider workload.
All returned page entries, totals and next offsets checksum-identical across policies and probes.
Timing: 3 processes per policy/case, 10 reads each; first read and last 7 warm reads reported separately. OS caches are warm from fixture creation; not physical disk cold-start timing.
GC occurs only before timing and after measurements; observed GC during timing is natural. WeakRef reachability probes use diagnostic GC in separate processes and do not contribute timing samples.
maxRSS is process-lifetime high water, not incremental app RAM. Sampled heap can miss peaks. Late pages may retain most entries because exact offset pagination requires the prefix.
Directory enumeration is not a filesystem transaction; concurrent filesystem changes can alter totals and pages in both implementations.
Final recorded benchmark ran after regression tests and native UI checks finished; no other task benchmark was run concurrently.
Periodic heap sampling and event-loop delay probes run in separate profile processes, outside the reported latency samples.
